reason: CP1 defines the two types of screening (real-time and batch) and their purposes, providing foundational knowledge for CP2 which discusses the technology used to implement these screening types.
CP2 covers screening technology at scale and integration, setting the stage for CP3 which delves into advanced methods like fuzzy logic and AI, and the calibration challenges they introduce.
CP3 discusses advanced screening methods and calibration in general, while CP4 applies these concepts to the specific domain of digital assets, highlighting unique challenges and practices.
